title: Amelia | Black Midi Dress with Sculptural Tiered Skirt
bodyHtml:
A striking midi with architectural drama: round neckline, fitted bodice, and a beautifully defined waist that flows into a tiered skirt with gorgeous volume and movement. The structured silhouette skims your figure without clinging, giving you effortless elegance from day to night. This is a rare find—the kind of dress you'll reach for again and again.

Why you'll love it

  • Fitted bodice that defines your silhouette and lengthens your line with poise
  • Defined waist that hits all the right curves and creates a harmonious profile
  • Tiered skirt with architectural cut—gives you volume, movement, and all-day comfort
  • Round neckline shows off your shoulders beautifully without fuss
  • Timeless black that's versatile enough for everything from garden parties to cocktail dinners
  • Perfect for weddings, events, and those nights when you want to feel truly yourself
  • A piece so well-designed it's genuinely hard to find elsewhere
